blurb: Sea Dog Cruising offers private boat charters for up to six guests with customizable itineraries including sightseeing tours, sunset cruises, dock & dine options, and special events. Guests can explore destinations such as Block Island, Long Island Sound's Gold Coast, Connecticut Shores, and Long Island's Forks. The charters provide a private experience with captain and crew, allowing guests to bring their own food and drinks and enjoy various activities on the water.
extraNote: Full payment required in advance to guarantee a reservation · If captain cancels due to safety reasons, full credit or refund · Vessel sails in light rain or cloudy skies · Typical gratuity is 20%, not included in price
